title: Boat Club Member Testimonials
seo_title: Boat Club Member Testimonials | Quest Express
seo_description: Hear what Quest Express Boat Club members say about boating the Illinois River from Heritage Harbor in Ottawa, IL, with none of the hassle of boat ownership.
body_html:
Hear what members are saying about Quest Express Boat Club at Heritage Harbor Ottawa.

What Members Are Saying

We deliberated for many years whether to get another boat or not, and if we did, what kind of boat? Quest Express was the solution to both questions. We discovered we love being on the water, but our lives are way too busy to actually own and take care of a boat, let alone haul it around, store it, and pay for a slip. Also, having access to different kinds of boats made it possible to do everything we were looking for: fishing, tubing, and cruising on the river. Quest Express is everything we love about boating, with none of the hassle.

Jeff & Family, Ottawa, IL

After owning a boat for 3 years and dealing with all the headaches that go with boating, there is nothing that compares to the Quest Express Boat Club. I spend a lot of time at full speed and it's nice to have the awesome staff at Quest handle the chores of boating. All I have to do is go online and make a painless reservation and the boat is waiting for me. It's fueled and in the water, ready for a day of fun! People think I'm crazy for jumping out of planes. I think people that miss out on the Boat Club are crazy!

Rook Nelson, Skydive Chicago CEO, Ottawa, IL

Quest Express has been the perfect program for us at Heritage Harbor. It couldn't be any easier. We book the boat online, the friendly, helpful staff is waiting for us when we get to the dock, we have a great time on the river and the staff is there to greet us when we return. We hand them the ropes and look forward to the next time. We thoroughly enjoy the freedom to boat along the Illinois River without worrying about all the details of boat ownership!

Harry and Ann, LaGrange, IL

Quest Express has been a wonderful addition to our family. Too often you hear people not wanting to enjoy boating fun due to the potential headaches that can come along with owning a boat. I can actually see the upside to both, but it's great that Quest Express gives people the choice on what best fits their lifestyle. Having purchased a townhome at Heritage Harbor overlooking the beautiful Illinois River in Ottawa, we wanted to further enjoy the area. We signed up for Quest Express last season and it was a great decision to say the least. We were able to enjoy many days out on the water; building memories with our two boys, our friends and our family is priceless. Too often people wait to live. Quest gives you the opportunity to start living now! The boats are kept clean and in great running condition and everyone from Jeff, to Linda, to Dennis and the rest of the team have been simply exceptional in their services and offerings. Certain decisions can change a life for the better, and our decision to join Quest Express has done just that. We are truly enjoying our membership!

John, Geneva, IL
